title: Growth projection outside the top decile without risk-officer sign-off
notes: declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: fin.growth_projection_decile plus fin.growth_signoff — market.growth_rate is the market, not the projection; decile basis per ADR-0018 anchoring undecided.
